design_targets.scope: full foothill-to-gate-to-summit main ascent including steps, turns, junctions and gate openings
acceptance: Measure usable floor and physical obstruction clearance, not shader road tint or terrain blend width
No local bottleneck narrower than 7m along the main ascent, including gate and stairs
Five parallel body-envelope paths must fit continuously across seams and turns
Character scale remains about 1.8m; terrain and architecture reservations are calibrated around this scale

checks.criterion: One complete mountain and foothill apron with clean background, no labels or other assets
Large usable summit reserve and broad mountain silhouette matching the requested spacious direction
Visible broad connected ascending switchbacks from foot to summit
Blue-gray weathered stone and restrained moss consistent with map art direction
No buildings, people, trees, water or fog fused into modeling image

limits: Image is a concept, not a finished GLB or an in-game screenshot.
7m minimum / 8m target clearance and five-person passage are requirements, not measurements verified from pixels.
Actual Meshy geometry must be inspected for continuous grade, edge support, usable summit area and narrow points.
Three.js gate and stairs will be independently fitted and checked to avoid bottlenecks.
